parent_objective: design a more expressive residual calibration probe after scalar gate produces only a narrow alpha 0.15 diagnostic candidate

public_gates: M788 designs a vector or structured residual calibration probe
M788 preserves the M568 base actor and M761 residual head as frozen references
M788 preserves the human-view deployable input contract
M788 defines explicit comparison targets against M780 alpha 0.125 M783 alpha 0.2 and M786 alpha 0.15
M788 blocks implementation PPO and promotion
forbidden_shortcuts: do not train actor or residual parameters
do not add oracle deploy-time inputs
do not weaken strict normal retention or intervention gap thresholds
do not claim broad generalization or true four-wheel physical fidelity

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: moves beyond scalar gate alpha scaling by designing action-component-aware residual calibration while preserving frozen actor/residual invariants
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no implementation training PPO or driver promotion
stop_condition: stop if design changes actor input contract
stop if design mutates base actor or M761 residual head
stop if design weakens M786 comparison thresholds
stop if design admits PPO or promotion
fallback_plan: if vector calibration design is too complex, design a simpler per-action-dimension gate first
if action component attribution is unclear, add an audit-only residual component sensitivity probe
if scalar gate evidence is judged sufficient, design source-diverse validation before implementation
if calibration remains local-gate-passing, stop residual calibration and return to corpus or architecture evidence
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M787 pivots from scalar gate to vector residual calibration

hypothesis: A vector or structured residual calibration design can address M787's scalar-gate limitation by suppressing risky normal action components without globally shrinking useful intervention residuals.
success_criteria: M788 documents the vector residual calibration objective
M788 documents deploy-time inputs and forbidden training-time-only signals
M788 defines strict normal retention and intervention gap gates
M788 defines comparison targets against M780 M783 and M786
M788 keeps implementation PPO and promotion blocked
failure_criteria: design changes the actor input contract
design mutates base actor or residual head
design omits comparison against scalar-gate baselines
decision_rule: M788 may only design the next vector or structured residual calibration probe. It must not implement, train, run PPO, mutate actor or residual parameters, or promote a checkpoint.
